summary: Fixes a real r0043 gap: --resume could not help a restore that began before the ledger existed (e.g. the actual r0042 E8 sandbox) -- it fell through to the ordinary destructive-guarded path. Adds --adopt-pre-ledger: each stage independently verifies pre-ledger durable output against the supplied archive before adopting it into a fresh ledger. Adds an interactive TTY recovery workflow so operators never need these flags. No migration/dependency/service changes.
